notes: Every source_url was fetched and parsed individually.
roster_group marks the repository's original 50 entries versus the 13 additional/hidden/NPC records from the full Redfreshet index.
playable reflects the page's 操作可能 field. A recruitment row with 加入不可 has recruitable=false, so NPCs are not treated as recruitable.
aptitude_tendency is the site's growth-table 得意傾向 summary.
skill_proficiencies records the site's 技能/特性/初期ランク table; no weakness is inferred from omissions.
learned_skills includes only rows whose 種類 is スキル; combat arts, magic and Blaze arts are excluded.
liked_gifts preserves every reaction shown on the character page (大好き/好き/好評 etc.) and each listed acquisition method.
Null/empty fields mean the source page did not provide that item; values are not guessed.

field_guide.id: redfreshet character entity id / URL slug
field_guide.display_name_ja: Japanese display name on the character page
field_guide.name_en: stable English key used by the existing 50-character site; stable romanized key for the additional 13
field_guide.playable: boolean parsed strictly from 操作可能 (あり/なし)
field_guide.routes: routes listed in the overview section
field_guide.initial_level / initial_class: initial information; null when the source page shows a dash
field_guide.recruitment: per-route join type, full condition, structured condition bullets, timing, and recruitable boolean
field_guide.growth_rates_percent: character growth rates by stat, in percent
field_guide.aptitude_tendency: site-authored 得意傾向 text based on growth values
field_guide.skill_proficiencies: trainable skill aptitudes (技能, 特性, 初期ランク)
field_guide.personal_skill: personal skill, effect and requirement from the character learnset table
field_guide.learned_skills: all skill-type learnset rows with method, requirement and effect
field_guide.gift_preference_hint: profile preference hint, not an item-level reaction
field_guide.liked_gifts: item-level gift reactions, price and acquisition methods shown for this character
field_guide.quick_zh: Traditional-Chinese quick-reference rendering; Japanese source fields remain authoritative
